Customization stylesheet for the TEI Stylesheets, created by Varians.
It imports the stylesheet {name} of the TEI Consortium. The parameters (xsl:param) and templates (xsl:template) written here take precedence over the imported ones; everything else comes from the TEI Stylesheets, which are never modified. The imported address is the official one: Varians reads it from the installed TEI Stylesheets, without network, as Oxygen does.

The “TEI: …” scenarios use the XSLT stylesheets of the TEI Consortium (github.com/TEIC/Stylesheets), installed once for all projects. At startup, Varians checks at most once a month whether a new version has been published; it installs it only with your consent.
